## What Would You Like to See?

Describe the new page, section, content, or feature.

## Why Does This Matter?

Who does this help — new users evaluating ZSR, existing users looking for support, contributors, press? Context helps prioritization.

## Type of Change

- [ ] New page or section
- [ ] Content update to an existing page
- [ ] Design / UX improvement
- [ ] Accessibility improvement
- [ ] Performance / SEO improvement
- [ ] Other:

## Additional Context

Mockups, examples from other sites, or relevant links, if any.
